content: rmcp (github.com/modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk) is the official Rust MCP SDK, 2.2.0 stable (2026-07-08) with a 3.0.0-beta.2 pre-release already circulating (signals ongoing API churn). Ships StreamableHttpService, a Tower service that mounts directly onto an existing axum::Router with a pluggable transport trait and automatic JSON-RPC schema generation - layers onto an existing axum app rather than requiring a separate server.
